evidence.description: PROP-AUTH-018 test does NOT verify Set-Cookie attributes for __Host-link_session; only checks store count
PROP-AUTH-020 duplicates PROP-AUTH-034 — calls pure function directly instead of spawning a process
serializeCookieAttributes has no dedicated Tier 1 test despite being listed in purity boundary map
handleAuthRequest exists in production code but is not specified in behavioral spec or verification architecture
PROP-AUTH-010 concurrent atomicity test uses single-threaded Map — cannot demonstrate true concurrency
Session endpoint always returns 200 { linked: true } regardless of cookie presence/validity
Absent Origin header defaults to empty string, causing 403 for legitimate same-origin requests
maskSensitiveLogFields only tested with lowercase keys, not mixed-case variants
Pure core imports node:crypto — platform I/O dependency in declared pure module
handleAuthRequest callback is a stub: no state verification, no Discord API calls, no link session issuance
Callback handler cannot return 401/500 failure codes — always returns 302
handleAuthRequest hardcodes test literals for clientId, redirectUri, state, cookie value
PROP-AUTH-012 integration test calls pure function directly, duplicating Tier 1 PROP-AUTH-031
Traceability matrix covers all 15 REQ + 4 NFR with PROP mappings; PROP numbering is non-contiguous but all IDs are traceable
PROP coverage table lists 15 Tier 1 + 18 Tier 2 + 3 Tier 3 = 36 PROPs; tier assignments and status fields are present for each
94 tests passed (57 Tier 1 + 37 Tier 2) — matches contract claim

summary: FAIL: 3 critical findings and 5 major findings across 4 dimensions exceed the contract pass threshold (0 critical, at most 2 major). The most severe issues are: (1) handleAuthRequest for /callback is a non-functional stub that cannot implement REQ-AUTH-002's atomic state verification flow (FIND-003, critical); (2) PROP-AUTH-018 test claims to verify __Host-link_session Set-Cookie attributes but only checks store count (FIND-001, critical); (3) Pure core imports node:crypto violating declared purity boundary (FIND-002, critical). Additionally, the session endpoint always returns 200 { linked: true } regardless of cookie presence (FIND-007), PROP-AUTH-010 atomicity test is trivially satisfied by single-threaded execution (FIND-004), PROP-AUTH-020 duplicates PROP-AUTH-034 instead of testing process exit (FIND-005), handleAuthRequest hardcodes test literals (FIND-006), and absent-Origin handling blocks legitimate same-origin requests (FIND-008).
